ticket: #331 (spec #297, M17): parent call notes and transcripts on Parent home
route: design skill, explore stage: 3 options; no final UI is built until Savar picks one
decision_question: Where do Maya's call notes live on Parent home, and how does a parent open a call's transcript?

sources.binding: DESIGN.md (warm look D-034, Parent home D-181/D-184, plain language rules), the current /account page (r301 after-account-laptop.png)
sources.content: The note sentences are exactly what src/lib/maya-call-note.ts writes for these facts (code-written facts; the italic line is the one warm AI sentence that passed the code check). The transcript is a sample in the shape of noteTranscript.

note: Static HTML mockups (option-a.html, option-b.html, option-c.html, shared.css, data.js; '#call' shows the transcript view), served locally and captured in the Aside browser. Sample data: Priya (parent), Leah (grade 3), Sam (grade 1, option B only). The first note sentence ('Leah called Maya about page 23, question 4.') is shown as the row's heading facts, not repeated.

A.name: Notes inside each child's card, transcript opens in place
A.tradeoff: Everything stays on one page with no new screen, but the card gets very long once a transcript is open or a child has many calls.

B.name: One 'Notes from Maya' feed for all children, transcript in a side panel (full screen on phones)
B.tradeoff: Best for scanning several children's calls at once, but it moves notes away from each child's card and the panel needs the most build work (focus, back button, phone sheet).

C.name: Only the latest note in each child's card, every call on its own page
C.tradeoff: Keeps Parent home short and gives each transcript a full page with a link to share or bookmark, but older notes are one tap away instead of on the home page.

invariants: A parent sees only their own children's notes (row-level security); admin test calls and test families never have a note
Every number and math claim in a note is written by code; the AI adds at most one warm sentence from an allowed word list
Short sentences in everyday words; Maya is named as an AI teaching assistant; no recording is kept
open_questions: Should the weekly minutes used and left (spec #297) sit beside the notes? Not in these mockups.
Option C needs a third screen, the list of all calls for one child; not drawn yet.
Tablet width (768 and 1024) is checked after a pick, as #331 asks.
